newsitem.title: USA: Chateau still committed to ROC deal.
newsitem.headline: Chateau still committed to ROC deal.

text.p: Chateau Properties Inc said Wednesday it remains committed to merging with ROC Communities Inc despite an extension of fellow mobile home park operator Manufactured Home Communities Inc's tender offer.
Earlier Wednesday, MHC said it extended its $26 a share cash tender offer until November 6. The previous offer was due to expire Wednesday night.

"They can extend it indefinitely," said Jeff Kellogg, president and chief executive of Chateau. "Our board has approved a definitive merger agreement and as management I'm trying to implement their decision."
Chateau previously rejected an unsolicited MHC offer and urged shareholders not to tender to the MHC cash offer. Chateau and ROC agreed to a revised merger last month.
MHC said as of Tuesday afternoon, about 2.7 million shares of Chateau's stock had been tendered to the offer.
Analysts have speculated that MHC, run by investor Sam Zell, may raise its per share bid for the company. A ROC and Chateau merger would create the largest mobile home operator, they said.
"The board is obligated to reanalyze any offers," Kellogg said. "If another offer comes in we'll analyze it, regardless of who it comes from."
